correctness.rationale: Greedy arch decomposition forces each of k length-three arches to be one of all six permutations; the converse concatenation is k-universal. Any length-three contiguous factor is in a block or crosses one adjacent boundary, so six-state transitions characterize avoidance for every k. Explicit determinant of I-zT and rank-one determinant-update polynomial reproduce F000=6z/(1-6z), F001=(6z-2z^2)/(1-6z+2z^2), F010=(6z-4z^2)/(1-6z+4z^2), F012=(5z+6z^2+2z^3)/(1-3z-5z^2-2z^3). An independent exact-symbolic computation reconstructed all four determinant identities. Equality-pattern classification is exhaustive for the 27 forbidden trigrams; Perron growth follows from accessible self-loop strong connectivity. Finite enumeration is not mistaken for proof of arbitrary k.
